articles.title: Chinese fraud victims lose key court battle over 61,000 Bitcoin
articles.snippet: Chinese fraud victims seeking to recover 61,000 seized Bitcoin face a legal setback after a UK court ruled that Chinese law governs their claims.

articles.title: Ledger implant tests Bitcoin ETFs as safer custodial solutions than hardware wallets
articles.snippet: The discovery of an unauthorized Ledger hardware implant reignited debate on whether Bitcoin ETFs are safer than self-custodying Bitcoin via hardware wallet devices.
